text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation asked me to recommend an 
easy-to-understand training textbook. 
While the two of us were reading the book 
I suggested—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Maximal oxygen... uptake... Oxygen 
volume... during swimming—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, nothing's sinking in...! Kgh, what 
a pathetic state I'm in... So shameful...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Losing focus that easily... how utterly 
pathetic of me. Pull yourself together, 
me!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps fatigued from the race, Win 
Variation seems to be having trouble 
concentrating. It might be best to review 
her schedule.
